policy: Historical scores are first invalidated for every affected task, then restored only when preserved output logs or a corrected deterministic rerun support exact rescoring. Remaining unavailable scores retain original_f1 and are excluded without imputation. Raw costs, timing, status, token, and memory measurements remain valid.
